members.name: key
members.doc: Stable identity. A series that survives a data change keeps its line and slides to its new ranks.

members.name: label
members.doc: Name at the end of the line, in the tooltip and in the table.

members.name: values
members.doc: One value per period, in the order of `periods`. Ranks are worked out from these.

members.name: color
members.doc: Any CSS color. Series default to the shared --series-* palette in data order, then neutral steps.

types.name: BumpChartProps
types.doc: Use a bump chart when the order matters more than the amounts: who led, who overtook whom, and when.

members.name: periods
members.doc: Label of each period on the axis, such as ["Jun", "Jul", "Aug"].

members.name: label
members.doc: What is ranked, such as "Regions ranked by monthly revenue". Names the chart for assistive technology.

members.name: order
members.doc: "desc" ranks the highest value first; "asc" ranks the lowest first, for times or costs.

members.name: rowHeight
members.doc: Vertical distance between two ranks in pixels.

members.name: formatValue
members.doc: Formats the value behind a rank in the tooltip and the table.

members.name: activeKey
members.doc: Controlled key of the series brought forward, or null for none. The others fade while one is forward.

members.name: defaultActiveKey
members.doc: Series brought forward on first render when uncontrolled.

members.name: onActiveChange
members.doc: Called when hover, touch or the keyboard brings another series forward, or lets go.

members.name: className
members.doc: Extra class on the root figure.
